meta.title: BulkTab – Bulk Product Tabs for WooCommerce demo
meta.description: WooCommerce with a sample product that shows a shared tab and a product tab.
meta.author: Waukegan Labs LLC

steps.code:
set_name( 'Organic Cotton T-Shirt' ); $product->set_slug( 'organic-cotton-t-shirt' ); $product->set_status( 'publish' ); $product->set_regular_price( '24.00' ); $product->set_short_description( 'A soft everyday tee. Scroll down to see the product tabs.' ); $product->set_description( '

Made from 100% organic cotton. This is the standard WooCommerce Description tab.

' ); $product->set_weight( '0.2' ); $product_id = $product->save(); update_post_meta( $product_id, '_bulktab_1_title', 'Care instructions' ); update_post_meta( $product_id, '_bulktab_1_content', '
  • Machine wash cold
  • Do not tumble dry

This tab belongs to this product only.

' ); wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'bulktab_tab', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Shipping & returns', 'post_content' => '

Free shipping on orders over $50. Returns accepted within 30 days.

This is a shared tab: it is written once and shown on every product.

', 'meta_input' => array( '_bulktab_key' => 'shipping-returns', '_bulktab_rules' => wp_json_encode( array( 'v' => 1, 'all' => true, 'groups' => array(), 'include' => array(), 'exclude' => array() ) ), ), ) ); if ( class_exists( '\BulkTab\RulesIndex' ) ) { \BulkTab\RulesIndex::rebuild(); } else { delete_option( 'bulktab_rules_index' ); }
